item.text: The first test run exposed a mistake in the test’s YAML construction: removing a field left its indentation behind, making the YAML invalid. I fixed that, and `go test ./internal/config` now passes. I’m also moving method validation ahead of the session-domain check so a missing provider field reports the required provider error even when the domain is absent.

item.text:
GitHub and enabled OIDC providers now fail startup when `client_id`, `client_secret`, or `redirect_address` is empty. Errors identify the provider and field; GitHub’s `read:org` check also uses the required error format.

Added YAML startup regression tests and updated the GitHub scope fixture. `go test ./internal/config ./internal/cmd` and `git diff --check` passed.
